reason: The maintainer requested: Merge all changes and ship a new release. This scoped decision covers the cross-platform Expo-backed haptics API, explicit iOS web overlay opt-in, and the invariant fixes merged in #74, versioned as 0.5.0 in #76. Automated validation covers the React 18/19 suite at 100% coverage, browser interactions, documentation, package metadata and real Expo 52/58 Metro consumers for iOS and Android. The implementation commit includes the final versioned manifests and lockfiles. No physical-device observations were recorded. Physical-device and VoiceOver certification remains pending in #9 and is disclosed; this decision does not certify hardware or apply to later versions.
